text.title: xUnit Testing Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. The `layer ==` branches route by what is under test; the flat `signal ==` branches route a concrete defect found in an existing suite.

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology — use Playwright / k6 across deployed services
unit tests with Mock<T>; constructor injection; FluentAssertions on collections

branch.question: Do you need the real DI graph + middleware?

conclusion.verdict: unit-test the controller with Mock service + per-branch Theory/Fact
Testcontainers Postgres via IAsyncLifetime + ICollectionFixture + Respawn for reset; SQLite-in-memory only when relational fidelity is not the point
add public partial class Program { } to Program.cs, then re-enter the tree
change the signature to async Task; enable xUnit1031 as warning-as-error
collapse into one [Theory] with [InlineData] rows named Method_Input_Expected
tighten the matcher to It.Is<T>(...) and assert the call with Verify(..., Times.Once)
remove the shared mutable state; move per-class setup into IClassFixture, or disable parallelization for that collection

text.example: layer=service_or_validator → constructor-injection → Mock<IInvoiceRepository> + per-branch Facts/Theories + FluentAssertions.
